critical_code_review_comments: letters.py deliver_due_letters(): if send_letter_email raises OR returns skipped, the letter is left in due-set and will be retried on every scheduler tick (every 15 min). For a persistently failing address this is harmless but noisy — consider a retry cap / permanent-failure flag after N attempts.

letters.py assist(): system_message inlines the user's writing samples verbatim (first 400 chars × 4 entries). For long/sensitive entries this is fine for MVP but no size cap — could push token counts if entries are long-form.

letters.py: fenced-code stripping (text.startswith('```')) is fragile — if the model wraps in ```json ... ``` the trim of backticks may not perfectly land the JSON braces. Current substring-by-{}/} search compensates, but a proper regex would be safer.
Twin.jsx toggleAbility uses `_` as an unused catch var — lint-clean but no user feedback on error (silent revert). Consider a toast on failure.

email_service.send_letter_email behaviour in test mode — auto-delivery test showed delivered=1 in preview env; make sure production SMTP/SendGrid is behind a feature flag so scheduler cannot accidentally send real emails during rehearsals.
